svg.title: The M3.1 Flash evidence stack
svg.desc: Diagram of five stacked evidence layers for MiniMax M3.1 Flash, each pairing what it supports with what it does not settle: identity, usage, vendor benchmarks, list price, and weights and license.

text.tspan: Five inspectable layers — each supports a narrower claim than the launch sentence.
Whether the model is any good.
The total cost of a real task.
You can download and use it
No inspected source independently measures the claimed 3× speed or one-third cost on a real agent workflow.
